name: Brammel
title: Farmer
examine: Third generation on this dirt and the only man alive bored by the Waking Ring. His fences are straight and his opinions are about rain.
lines: Wheat's in. Carrots are thinking about it.
Hens lay where they please. Coop, mostly. Long grass when they're feeling poetic.
People come out of the stones. Aye. And rain comes out of the sky, and I've a field.
